notes:
Context: Railhaven is a mid-market B2B SaaS providing search and recommendations for logistics partners. They want to replace a noisy keyword search with vector-based semantic search and to offload embedding generation.

Primary objectives:
- Validate hosted embeddings pipeline for nightly batch of ~300k documents/day (they expect to de-duplicate; POC subset is 50k).
- Assess end-to-end latency for interactive search traffic (peak 80 qps, typical 30 qps).
- Determine TCO: Redwood hosted compute + chosen vector DB + networking. Target blended cost <$0.35 per 1k embeddings incl vector DB ops.

Technical details / constraints:
- Infra: AWS EKS, Kafka for event stream, S3 for archival. Prefer Redwood to push embeddings into managed Pinecone or Weaviate. Also evaluating self-hosted pgvector on RDS/EC2 for cost control.
- Batch job: nightly window 02:00-05:00 UTC, target embed throughput >= 12k embeddings/min to finish within window. Current test shows ~9k/min without optimizations.
- Query SLO: p50 < 60ms (NA), p95 < 300ms. They can accept higher p95 for long-tail but execs want low p50.
- Model preference: open models (Llama-derived / Mistral family) recommended by internal ML; wants Redwood to show best embedding model options and mapped cost/perf.
- Observability: needs cost by route, per-model latency histograms, and per-embedding job accounting for billing.
- Security: SOC2 required; SAML SSO for internal users; KMS integration mandatory; EU data residency required for EU customers only.

POC deliverables (planned):
- Hosted API ingest + upsert into Pinecone test index for 7 days; collect metrics: embeddings/sec, average upsert latency, search p50/p95, egress MB/day.
- Short report with recommendations on batching size, concurrency, and whether Dedicated reserved GPUs make sense for cost/latency.
- Migration checklist for Hosted -> Dedicated pilot (networking, VPC peering, model pinning).

Commercial notes:
- They requested a pilot priced as credits on hosted tier; if POC meets throughput and p50 target, they're interested in a 3-6 month Dedicated pilot with monthly commit.
- AE asked Revenue for two pricing options: (A) Hosted pilot + 6mo dedicated at X commit; (B) Hosted pilot + 3mo dedicated with higher unit costs but faster start.

SE observations / recommendations:
- Upsert latency into vector DB currently driving p95; test direct write from Redwood vs batched S3-based ingestion.
- Recommend Redwood Optimize review to tune batching and to propose quantized embedding model if acceptable for recall.

Quotes from customer:
- "We need to show ops and finance a predictable per-embed number before we commit to Dedicated." — Lina Rao, CTO.
- "If p50 is stable under load and cost's reasonable we'll push to a pilot this quarter." — Mateo Gomez, Head of Product.

Open actions:
- SE Diego to deliver two Dedicated pricing scenarios by 2026-02-28.
- Customer to confirm vector DB choice (Pinecone vs Weaviate vs pgvector) by 2026-03-10.
- Security follow-up call scheduled 2026-02-26 to confirm KMS/residency artifacts.
